## Poll GitHub Actions for bizOS failures

Runs every 15 minutes. Optional `GITHUB_TOKEN` (fine-grained PAT with `actions:read` on pmwasim/bizOS) raises rate limits; public repos work unauthenticated.

Works with localhost n8n — no inbound webhook from GitHub required.
Dedupes by workflow run id. Delivery: Mailpit or `BIZOS_OPS_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL`.

meta.description: Polls GitHub Actions for new bizOS failures. Token optional for public repos.
